nodes.label: Shared 8-Slot Tool and Accent Color Scheme
nodes.norm_label: shared 8-slot tool and accent color scheme
nodes.rationale: Every pack has 8 characters; column N in each pack holds the same tool (hammer, watering can, paintbrush, magnifying glass, pickaxe, hook/cane, lantern, shovel) and the same accent color, so tools and colors are shared across packs and only the creature art differs.

nodes.label: npm run install-hooks
nodes.rationale: Backs up settings, keeps other hooks, idempotent; rerun after Node version switch or TS move.

nodes.label: Hook Path Baked Into ~/.claude/settings.json
nodes.rationale: Moving or renaming the hook requires re-running install-hooks and restarting Claude Code sessions.

nodes.label: Use app.getAppPath() for Repo-Root Files
nodes.rationale: Works from source and packaged app; __dirname points into out/.

nodes.label: Script Load Order (gnome.js, packs, app.js)
nodes.rationale: Classic scripts loaded from ../out/renderer/: gnome.js first, then capybaras, bats, cats, bigfoot packs, then app.js.

nodes.label: _claude_pid Dead Session Sweep
nodes.rationale: Hook sends null when unsure because a wrong PID removes a live agent.

nodes.label: Packs Are IIFEs Registering on window.PACKS
nodes.norm_label: packs are iifes registering on window.packs
nodes.rationale: Packs use window.packTools (toolSVG, toolAngleFor); a new pack needs a script tag in index.html and a PACKS entry in src/main.ts.

nodes.label: Agent Status States (busy, needs you, finished, napping)
nodes.norm_label: agent status states (busy, needs you, finished, napping)

nodes.label: Drawer Slides Out When Leaving VS Code
nodes.norm_label: drawer slides out when leaving vs code

nodes.label: One Character Per Agent
nodes.rationale: Each project folder always gets the same gnome so users learn to recognize them.

nodes.label: Pack SVG Part Classes (g-body, g-head, g-arm-tool...)
nodes.norm_label: pack svg part classes (g-body, g-head, g-arm-tool...)
nodes.rationale: Using shared part classes gives packs the shared animations for free; hat color drives progress bar and accents.

nodes.label: Platform Notes (macOS, Windows PowerShell, Linux xdotool)
nodes.norm_label: platform notes (macos, windows powershell, linux xdotool)

nodes.label: Renderer TS Files Are Classic Scripts
nodes.norm_label: renderer ts files are classic scripts
nodes.rationale: No top-level import/export in renderer/*.ts or tsc emits exports and the page breaks; types via import('./types').X, shared values via window.*. Relies on moduleDetection auto in tsconfig because TS 7 defaults to modules.

nodes.label: Held Prompts (open HTTP response until resolve/release)
nodes.norm_label: held prompts (open http response until resolve/release)

nodes.label: server.json Port/Token Discovery
nodes.rationale: src/server.ts writes port and token to ~/.gnome-watch/server.json so the hook can find the app.

nodes.label: Answer Permission Prompts and Questions Without Switching
nodes.norm_label: answer permission prompts and questions without switching

nodes.label: How It Works (hook -> localhost HTTP -> app)
nodes.norm_label: how it works (hook -> localhost http -> app)
nodes.rationale: Blocking only for permission prompts and questions; everything else returns immediately so Claude is never slowed.

nodes.label: 9.5 Minute Prompt Handback
nodes.rationale: Claude Code gives a hook up to 10 minutes, so the app hands the prompt back to VS Code at ~9.5 minutes.

nodes.label: core.ts Has No Electron Imports
nodes.rationale: Keeps all state and hook handling testable with plain Node.

nodes.label: Hook Must Always Exit 0
nodes.rationale: Hook must never break or slow Claude Code; returns fast for non-blocking events and does nothing if the app is down.

nodes.label: Hook -> Server -> Core -> IPC -> Renderer Flow
nodes.norm_label: hook -> server -> core -> ipc -> renderer flow
nodes.rationale: Claude Code runs out/hook/gnome-hook.js, which posts over HTTP 127.0.0.1 with a token to src/server.ts, which hands events to src/core.ts, which pushes state over IPC to renderer/.

nodes.label: Don't Run Dev App Alongside Installed App
nodes.norm_label: don't run dev app alongside installed app
nodes.rationale: A second instance overwrites server.json (stealing hooks) and deletes it on quit.

nodes.label: Tests Never Touch Real Home Dir
nodes.norm_label: tests never touch real home dir
nodes.rationale: test/core.test.ts sets HOME to a temp folder then require()s src/, because imports are hoisted and server.ts reads home dir at load time.
